deathCause: Died of a winter chill and a tired heart.

childrenAfterContinuation.name: D’Arcy
childrenAfterContinuation.bio: A small, turnip-shaped continuation of your line. Bites when teething.

worldMemories.summary: D’Arcy was supported through a formative year.
D’Arcy pursued the ambition to become wealthy.
You insist on a public list and exemptions read aloud. D’Arcy objects to giving the levy quite so many opportunities to understand it.

childrenAfterContinuation.name: O’Neill
childrenAfterContinuation.bio: A small, turnip-shaped continuation of your line. Bites when teething.

worldMemories.summary: O’Neill was supported through a formative year.
You save the usable timber and accept less space. O’Neill lends a hand after discovering that you intend to sleep under this work yourself.

history.choiceId: young_washing_judge:Hold the clean cloth yourself
history.summary: Simon gives you one corner. Your face becomes cleaner and the floor rather less so.

history.choiceId: young_sleep_inspection:Call for the night inspection
history.summary: Isolde arrives with one shoe on the wrong foot. The inspection passes; the inspector remains unsatisfied.
Wat is adopted into the household.

history.choiceId: young_candle_shadow:Watch from beneath the blanket
causes: THE EXTRA PERSON ON THE WALL
history.summary: Isolde moves the candle. The stranger goes home without requiring you to be brave for an audience.

history.choiceId: young_blanket_trade:Hold on to the familiar corner
history.summary: Simon washes the other end first. The compromise leaves you holding a small but recognised country.
The Outlaws lost influence in Swineford.

history.choiceId: young_river_boat:Charge spectators for the launch
causes: THE BOAT THAT HAS NO INTEREST IN COMMAND
history.summary: Maud demands a refund on behalf of the spectators. The spectators are three children and one unmoved dog.

history.choiceId: base_turnip_oracle:Study the crack rather than buy the prophecy
history.summary: You learn how frost split the root and improve household food planning. The forecast is useful precisely because nobody claims it speaks.

history.choiceId: young_measuring_door:Improve the measurement with your heels
causes: THE DOOR THAT RECORDS YOUR HEIGHT
history.summary: Simon marks the extra height with a tiny drawing of your feet. The record is accurate in a particularly inconvenient way.

history.choiceId: base_pig_trial:Demand harsh justice
history.summary: The pig is sentenced to public shame. It appears immune.

history.choiceId: peasant_quack_doctor:Ask what happens when the stone cools
history.summary: Brother Oswin recommends another appointment. You decline with a better understanding of which part of the treatment needs constant warming.

history.choiceId: peasant_sweating_sickness:Sweat it out and pray
history.summary: The fever digs in for the long haul. This sickness will not pass quickly.
Elswyth is recognised as ruler: the documented succession.
Hugh is born.

history.choiceId: base_bell_ringer:Ring it first
history.summary: You ring early. Half the village arrives angry, dressed, and spiritually confused.

history.choiceId: single_chain_wounded_midwife:Insist on the name you were promised
history.summary: The midwife attempts too much and the care becomes less safe. Aelfric remembers your contribution to a problem you did not have to solve with your hands.

history.choiceId: single_chain_strangers_map:Ask permission and share any proceeds
causes: THE TREASURE MAP ENDS UNDER A BED
history.summary: The neighbour admits there is an old cellar and lets you inspect it. Joan looks disappointed that the first tool you used was a question.

history.choiceId: base_leeches_for_rent:Ask whether the landlord has agreed
history.summary: The seller has not consulted the landlord. You gain judgement while the leeches continue to make a much simpler living.

history.choiceId: life_sermon_own_sin:Insist that accusations require evidence
causes: THE SERMON WITH YOUR MEASURES IN IT
history.summary: The allegation is left out for want of evidence. Brother Oswin must deliver the moral point without the convenient pleasure of naming you.

history.choiceId: young_forbidden_chapter:Read it critically rather than circulate it
causes: THE BOOK THAT SHOULD NOT BE THIS INTERESTING
history.summary: You identify the argument and its weaknesses. Maud is disappointed to discover that scandal can require homework.
The Outlaws lost influence in Swineford.

history.choiceId: life_herbal_labels:Leave both bundles untouched
history.summary: You refuse the gamble and gain some judgement. Not every uncertain meal needs a conclusive ending.
Élodie is born.

history.choiceId: life_scaffold_blessing:Refuse to test the argument with your body
history.summary: Cuthbert objects to your lack of confidence. The loose peg lies beside the platform, displaying admirable patience with both of you.

history.choiceId: single_chain_crown_levy:Demand a public drawing with exemptions read aloud
causes: THE LOTS ARE DRAWN BEFORE THE DRAWING
history.summary: The list is remade before witnesses. Beatrice complains about delay while hiding the pen that predicted the first result.
O’Neill is born.

history.choiceId: life_saint_two_skulls:Ask for the history of both objects
history.summary: Aldric moves the smaller skull behind the larger one. The saint has become considerably older in the time it takes to ask one question.
The Crown extended influence in Swineford.

history.choiceId: life_jealous_petition:Give a full account and change the arrangement
history.summary: You answer the question and make room for your spouse’s worry. Trust improves through a less entertaining use of the evening.

history.choiceId: rival_wagered_challenge:Keep your gold and walk away
causes: YOUR RIVAL HAS HIRED A DRUMMER
history.summary: You leave the wet-pillow debate to the experts. Your purse remains undefeated.

history.choiceId: peasant_lords_tourney:Sell pies where the losers come down
history.summary: You earn nine gold supplying an audience with no shortage of dramatic landings. The best customers eat without taking their eyes off the field.

history.choiceId: life_eye_cure:Demand evidence from a patient rather than cutlery
causes: THE MAN WHO CAN POLISH YOUR SIGHT
history.summary: You ask when the polished spoon last needed to recognise its family. Brother Oswin finds the demonstration less persuasive under questioning.

history.choiceId: life_furnace_quick_lime:Wait for proper cooling and protection
causes: THE WHITE DUST UNDER THE LID
history.summary: You wait for the safe handling. Elswyth concedes that impatience is cheaper than a burn only until somebody obeys it.

history.choiceId: comic_rival_praise:Suggest a more modest first attempt
history.summary: Sir Roderick tries it and succeeds. You are left in the awkward position of having given useful advice.

history.choiceId: life_taxed_chickens:Challenge the expense list publicly
history.summary: You make the claim difficult to defend and gain standing with the Commons. Cuthbert becomes a rival with a remarkably poultry-shaped grievance.

history.choiceId: life_counterfeit_pardon:Give the blank to the clerk as evidence
causes: THE PARDON WITH ROOM FOR A NAME
history.summary: You expose the scheme and gain standing with the Crown. Merek knows exactly who supplied the paper.
The Church extended influence in Swineford.

history.choiceId: single_chain_grain_wall:Sort and dry what can be saved
causes: THE WALL THAT HID THE DAMP GRAIN
history.summary: You lose a day’s strength and rescue useful stores. Wulfric agrees that food improves a household’s appearance best from inside its occupants.
The Church extended influence in Swineford.

history.choiceId: life_spouse_guest:Agree on a leaving date together
causes: THE GUEST WHO CAME WITH THE MARRIAGE
history.summary: You and Hilda settle the invitation without a public quarrel. Household trust improves and the spare blanket remains only a blanket.

history.choiceId: single_chain_bellmakers_sight:Take the credit for the whole casting
causes: THE BELL FOUNDER CANNOT READ HIS MARK
history.summary: You collect a fee and the applause. Aelfric keeps the mould and the knowledge of who actually knew how to use it.

history.choiceId: life_court_lie:Refuse to become the rehearsal’s witness
history.summary: You reject the falsehood and gain a reputation for independence. Emma loses trust in you as an accomplice.
The Commons extended influence in Swineford.

history.choiceId: life_family_ladder:Charge for this year’s use (5g)
causes: THE LADDER THAT IS NEVER HOME
history.summary: Mabel pays five gold and becomes much less neighbourly. The ladder has earned more than most apprentices.
The Guilds extended influence in Swineford.

history.choiceId: life_saint_dog_bone:Withdraw the claim until there is evidence
history.summary: You withdraw the claim. Hugh regards the dog as a neglected witness for the defence, though it appears principally interested in the bone.

history.choiceId: single_chain_spoon_claim:Sell your claim for a fair payment
causes: THE CHRISTENING SPOON IN THE WRONG SLEEVE
history.summary: Hugh pays five gold for the spoon and the right to stop describing your grandmother.

history.choiceId: single_story_divided_parish:Fund parish food instead of another sermon (8g)
causes: THE NAVE HAS ACQUIRED A BORDER
history.summary: The food crosses the aisle without difficulty. Maud admits that hunger has been a rather efficient ecumenist.

history.choiceId: life_smuggler_coffin:Leave the uncle to his own household
history.summary: You decline before taking the load. Whatever is in the coffin will have to find someone else to be late for it.

history.choiceId: life_quarry_shortcut:Turn back before the descent begins
history.summary: You give up the excursion and preserve your health. Gilbert keeps the story of the shortcut for a more agreeable audience.

history.choiceId: life_missing_constable_boot:Return the boot and its contents
history.summary: You return the find and improve your reputation. Authority is restored to a matching pair.

history.choiceId: base_spare_toe_relic:Ask it to bless you
history.summary: Nothing happens. The seller says the toe is shy before crowds.

history.choiceId: single_story_healers_burden:Give priority to those who can pay you
causes: THIRTEEN DOORS, FOUR PAIRS OF HANDS
history.summary: You collect the fees. Walter has to deliver the refusal to the other doors and does not forgive the errand.

history.choiceId: single_story_role_commoner:Buy out your service (8g)
history.summary: The steward accepts eight gold and stops praising the spiritual value of labour. Your hay is gathered before the rain.

history.choiceId: life_sibling_fire_sale:Help make a fair sale
causes: THE HEIRLOOMS ON THE MARKET CLOTH
history.summary: You accept that survival can require parting with things. The family’s standing improves and Hugh trusts you more.
The Guilds extended influence in Swineford.

history.choiceId: single_story_ashes_household:Patch a smaller room together
causes: THE HOUSEHOLD THAT FITS IN THE YARD
history.summary: You save the usable timber and accept less space. O’Neill lends a hand after discovering that you intend to sleep under this work yourself.

history.choiceId: base_goose_witness:Blame the pie
history.summary: You accuse the pie of tempting honest men. The court pauses, then fines you for nonsense.

history.choiceId: life_innocent_fine:Request the original charge and witnesses
history.summary: You contest the clerical shortcut and gain local standing. Percival is disappointed to discover that assistance can be made unnecessary.

history.choiceId: single_story_war_swineford:Help make the muster fair
causes: THE CART THAT HAS ALREADY ENLISTED
history.summary: You insist on a public list and exemptions read aloud. D’Arcy objects to giving the levy quite so many opportunities to understand it.

history.choiceId: single_chain_granary_rats:Record an honest food allowance instead
causes: THE RATS HAVE ACQUIRED A KEY
history.summary: The hungry household receives a proper ration. Mabel signs for it; the sacks stop having to develop holes to feed somebody.

history.choiceId: single_chain_scholar_bone:Ask for the actual finding
history.summary: The bone is an ordinary sheep’s. Walter is relieved until you ask for the answer in ordinary writing as well.

history.choiceId: faith_pardoner_sale:Ask for a receipt
history.summary: He flees at the word "receipt." The crowd learns a valuable theology of paperwork, and repeats the story at every fair for a decade.

history.choiceId: life_sibling_guarantor:Accept the obligation, not the forgery
causes: YOUR NAME UNDER SOMEONE ELSE’S DEBT
history.summary: You record a real twenty-gold debt in your own name. Hugh promises to remember it; the lender has a more dependable method.
Shared buckets meet the immediate need until the well is repaired.

causes: Died of a winter chill and a tired heart.
history.summary: Cuthbert died at 55. Died of a winter chill and a tired heart.

causes: Died of a winter chill and a tired heart.
history.summary: D’Arcy inherited the unfinished story of Swineford.
